purpose: Development-only test of a single cost-aware tail-benefit classifier at challenger compile index65, using only pre-v1-confirmation evidence. The model estimates whether any future seeded endpoint will beat the retained two-arm incumbent after an uninformative prefix. This is a simpler one-decision approximation to finite-horizon continuation value.

development_sources.status: failed confirmation formally retired for future development

decision_state: Only cases whose challenger has not exhausted and has not produced a verified endpoint better than the incumbent by compile index65 enter the classifier dataset. Cases with a positive certificate by 65 deterministically finish full; exhausted cases deterministically stop.
label: 1 iff exhaustive continuation after index65 eventually produces any verified challenger endpoint with live_nodes < two-arm incumbent live_nodes; otherwise 0.

development_validation.rule: Fit scaler+model on three families and predict the held-out family; concatenate all out-of-fold probabilities. No model-family sweep.

threshold_selection: Among unique out-of-fold predicted probabilities, choose the largest threshold whose positive-example recall is >=0.80. This minimizes deployment continuation rate subject to the declared empirical recall target. Ties choose the larger threshold. Also report gain-weighted recall, continuation rate, precision and family-specific false negatives. This is development selection only, not confirmation evidence.
final_fit: After threshold selection, refit the identical scaler+logistic model on all eligible development states and persist scaler mean/scale, coefficients, intercept and threshold verbatim before any new confirmation outcomes.
deployment_policy: Always buy the first 65 challenger compilations unless exhausted. If a positive certificate occurs by then, finish full challenger. Otherwise, at index65 continue full iff model probability >= frozen threshold; if below threshold return incumbent. Retain incumbent throughout; no positive quality regret versus two-arm is possible.
cost_accounting: Charge all 65-prefix BDD compilations plus all full challenger compilations on continued cases. Model feature/inference wall time reported separately. Training cost reported separately and not subtracted from deployment compute.
scope: Synthetic positive-monotone graph 2-CNF ROBDD ordering. This development step cannot establish generalization.
